name: addressing-no-interrupt
_provenance: Johnny-trt.48 — the repeatable regression for the trt.46 multi-agent foundation, flipped to the trt.47 arbitration expectations: an addressed_to step is answered by exactly the named agent (router peer selectivity — the selective stub parses the roster block out of the rendered prompt); an unaddressed step by exactly one turn-claim winner, the loser terminalizing no_reply(peer_answered). The trt.46 invariants still hold throughout: floor holds never overlap, audio stays inside the speaker's own holds, the co-agent's speech is peer-labeled.
